---
applyTo: "apps/academy/web/**/*"
---

The domain exists in the academy/domain directory and you can import it using "@ulthar/academy-domain". The web project is a React project with file-based routing. We are using storybook, follow the examples already provided. It is a simple learning platform. The design must be simple with a dark theme (no choice, always dark theme).

Use argentinean spanish for all the text in the site, but not for the code.
